name: RunActionDialog
intent: Execute a typed ontology action: a parameter form generated from the action type, gated on the acting user's groups.
when: Running an action against a record
Any surface offering a typed, permissioned operation
whenNot: Editing the action type itself -> open its detail page

chooseOver.because: The form is generated from the action type's parameters, including static and fromObjectProperty defaults and an instance picker, and the run is gated on the acting user's groups rather than trusted.

actingUser.note: Defaults to the ontology admin; the run is gated on these groups.

preset.note: Values preset by another surface; shows the prefilled chip.

instancesFor.note: Instance picker source; omit and objectRef parameters fall back to free text.

states.prefilled: Preset values arrive from another surface and are chipped as such.
states.denied: The acting user's groups do not permit the run, and the dialog says so.
states.derived: fromObjectProperty defaults refill when their source parameter changes.

evaluationCriteria: A user outside the permitted groups cannot run.
fromObjectProperty defaults refill when their source changes.

lineage.authoredBy: Promoted from the WC3 action type detail page (2026-08-26)
notes: Was exported from its module but absent from the package exports map — public to the monorepo, private to every consumer.
Promoted in group B of the missing-widgets template review.

usage: Use RunActionDialog when you need to display content that temporarily overlays the main interface. This component is useful for focused interactions, confirmations, or supplementary information.
RunActionDialog should be used sparingly as overlays interrupt the user's workflow. Reserve this component for important interactions that require user attention or action before continuing.

anatomy.description: RunActionDialog is composed of the following parts:

parts.name: RunActionDialogTrigger
parts.description: Element that opens the dialog when activated.

parts.name: RunActionDialogContent
parts.description: Container for the dialog content and overlay.

parts.name: RunActionDialogHeader
parts.description: Header section containing title and description.

bestPractices.title: Use clear action labels
bestPractices.description: Write button text that clearly describes the action, like 'Save changes' or 'Delete item'.

bestPractices.title: Avoid vague labels
bestPractices.description: Don't use generic text like 'Click here' or 'Submit' without context.

bestPractices.title: Use appropriate variants
bestPractices.description: Choose button variants that match the action importance - primary for main actions, secondary for alternatives.

bestPractices.title: Don't overuse primary buttons
bestPractices.description: Avoid having multiple primary buttons in the same view, which creates visual confusion.

bestPractices.title: Handle loading states
bestPractices.description: Show loading indicators when actions take time to complete.

bestPractices.title: Don't block without feedback
bestPractices.description: Never disable a button during processing without showing a loading state.
